user.title: Microgreens
user.description: Plan, grow and harvest microgreen trays. Crops, plots and plantings are managed in the Microgreens panel in the sidebar. If Microgreens 0.1 was installed before, its plots, crops and trays are imported.

init.title: Notifications
init.description: Who is told about the day's tasks, and when. The same settings are on the Settings tab of the Microgreens panel.

data_description.notify_targets: Notify services or notify entities, for example notify.mobile_app_phone.
data_description.persistent_notification: The digest also appears in the Home Assistant sidebar and disappears once every task in it is done.
data_description.digest_enabled: One message a day listing everything due: harvests, uncovering, watering, sowing, soaking.
data_description.reminder_enabled: A second message only if something is still open (a harvest only on its last day).
data_description.notification_actions: Companion app notifications get a "Watered all" button and open the panel when tapped.

text_too_long.message: The text is longer than {max} characters.

invalid_number.message: {field} must be a whole number from {min} to {max}.

invalid_date.message: {field} is not a valid date here.

invalid_id.message: A plot ID may only use letters, digits, - and _ (up to 32).

invalid_order.message: The new order must list every plot exactly once.

invalid_backup.message: This is not a Microgreens backup.

plot_in_use.message: {plot} still has plantings. Harvest or discard them first.

no_plan.message: {plot} has no planned sowing to confirm. Give a crop to sow a new tray.

unknown_history.message: That history entry no longer exists.

not_a_plot_device.message: That device is not a Microgreens plot.

sown_in_future.message: A tray that is already sown cannot have a sowing date in the future.

not_sown.message: This tray is only planned; confirm the sowing first.

shift_too_far.message: The light stage cannot be shorter than one day.

confirm.title: Remove the old Microgreens 0.1 entry
confirm.description: Microgreens now runs as ha_microgreens and has imported the plots, crops and trays of the old "microgreens" entry. Submit to delete the old entry. Then remove the old Microgreens 0.1 download (custom_components/microgreens) in HACS or by hand, and restart.

sow.name: Sow
sow.description: Sow a crop on a plot (today or a past date), plan it (a later date), or without a crop confirm the plot's planned sowing.

plot.name: Plot
plot.description: Plot ID or name, for example A1.

device_id.name: Plot device
device_id.description: The plot's device, instead of Plot.

crop.name: Crop
crop.description: Crop ID or name. Leave empty to confirm the plot's planned sowing.

date.name: Date
date.description: Sowing date. Defaults to today; a later date makes it a plan.

label.name: Label
label.description: Sticker or batch code. Defaults to the plot ID and date.

notes.name: Notes
notes.description: Free text kept with the tray.

water.name: Water
water.description: Mark a plot's tray as watered today. Without a plot, every tray that is due.

plot.name: Plot
plot.description: Plot ID or name. Leave empty for every tray that is due.

device_id.name: Plot device
device_id.description: The plot's device, instead of Plot.

uncover.name: Uncover
uncover.description: Record that a plot's tray came out of the blackout today.

device_id.name: Plot device
device_id.description: The plot's device, instead of Plot.

harvest.name: Harvest
harvest.description: Harvest a plot's tray and record it in the history.

device_id.name: Plot device
device_id.description: The plot's device, instead of Plot.

notes.name: Notes
notes.description: Added to the tray's notes in the history.

discard.name: Discard
discard.description: Throw a failed tray away (recorded in the history), or cancel a planned one.

device_id.name: Plot device
device_id.description: The plot's device, instead of Plot.

notes.name: Notes
notes.description: Added to the tray's notes in the history.

shift.name: Shift
shift.description: Move a sown tray's harvest by some days, or a planned tray's sowing date.

device_id.name: Plot device
device_id.description: The plot's device, instead of Plot.

days.name: Days
days.description: Positive to postpone, negative to bring forward.

send_digest.name: Send digest
send_digest.description: Send today's task digest now, to every configured target.
